packet.headline_seed: Roof collapse kills 14 schoolchildren in Pakistan
packet.description_seed: Two people are taken into custody after the incident at a tuition centre in the Kahna suburb of Lahore.

what: Roof collapse kills 14 schoolchildren in Pakistan

clean_source_blocks.text: Fourteen children died after the roof of a building near Lahore collapsed on top of them, officials say. The incident happened at a private tuition centre in the Kahna suburb of the Pakistani city. Young children under the age of 10 are among those to have been taken from the scene. Authorities launched an investigation into the collapse, and two people were taken into custody as part of the initial inquiry. Farooq Ahmed, a spokesman for the emergency service Rescue 1122, told the BBC they had received a call about the incident at 16:45 (12:45 BST). He said that the rescue operation had been completed within one hour, and most people recovered were between seven and 11 years old. Another five people are thought to be injured. ---
Two people are taken into custody after the incident at a tuition centre in the Kahna suburb of Lahore.

LAHORE: A roof collapse at a tutoring center under-construction in Pakistan's eastern city of Lahore on Tuesday killed at least 14 schoolchildren, police and rescue officials said. Eight other children were also injured and were being treated at a hospital, senior police official Faisal Kamran said, adding that the owner of the tutoring center and another person have been arrested. Kamran said rescuers were continuing to search through the rubble after receiving reports that more children could be trapped beneath the debris. He said the tutoring center was housed in an aging building and that the roof of an unfinished second floor apparently collapsed because of poor-quality construction.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Fourteen children died after the roof of a building near Lahore collapsed on top of them, officials say.

The incident happened at a private tuition centre in the Kahna suburb of the Pakistani city.

Young children under the age of 10 are among those to have been taken from the scene.

Authorities launched an investigation into the collapse, and two people were taken into custody as part of the initial inquiry.

Farooq Ahmed, a spokesman for the emergency service Rescue 1122, told the BBC they had received a call about the incident at 16:45 (12:45 BST).

He said that the rescue operation had been completed within one hour, and most people recovered were between seven and 11 years old.

Another five people are thought to be injured.

---

[Lähde: NBC News]
A roof collapse at a tutoring center under-construction in Pakistan’s eastern city of Lahore on Tuesday killed at least 14 schoolchildren, police and rescue officials said.

Eight other children were also injured and were being treated at a hospital, senior police official Faisal Kamran said, adding that the owner of the tutoring center and another person have been arrested.

Kamran said rescuers were continuing to search through the rubble after receiving reports that more children could be trapped beneath the debris. He said the tutoring center was housed in an aging building and that the roof of an unfinished second floor apparently collapsed because of poor-quality construction.

Pakistan’s President Asif Ali Zardari expressed grief over the collapse of the roof of an evening school building in Lahore. In a statement, he offered condolences to the families of the victims, prayed for the speedy recovery of those injured, and said effective safety measures were needed to prevent similar tragedies.

Building collapses are common in Pakistan, where construction standards are often poorly enforced. Many structures are built with substandard materials, and safety regulations are frequently ignored to reduce costs.

payload.title: Katto romahti opetuskeskuksessa Lahoressa, ainakin 14 koululaista kuoli
payload.summary: Ainakin 14 koululaista on kuollut rakennuksen katon romahdettua yksityisessä opetuskeskuksessa Pakistanin Lahoren Kahnan esikaupunkialueella. Viranomaiset ovat ottaneet kaksi ihmistä kiinni ja aloittaneet tutkinnan.
payload.content:
Ainakin 14 koululaista on kuollut Pakistanin Lahoressa, kun yksityisen opetuskeskuksen katto romahti lasten päälle Kahnan esikaupunkialueella. Poliisi- ja pelastusviranomaisten mukaan useita lapsia loukkaantui, ja viranomaiset ovat ottaneet kaksi ihmistä kiinni tapauksen alustavan tutkinnan yhteydessä.

## Lapset jäivät romahtaneen katon alle

Onnettomuus tapahtui tiistaina Pakistanin itäosassa sijaitsevassa Lahoressa. Pelastuspalvelu Rescue 1122:n edustaja Farooq Ahmed kertoi BBC:lle, että hälytys tapahtumapaikalta saatiin kello 16.45 paikallista aikaa eli 12.45 Britannian aikaa. Hänen mukaansa pelastusoperaatio saatiin päätökseen noin tunnissa.

Viranomaisten mukaan suurin osa raunioista löydetyistä lapsista oli 7–11-vuotiaita. Tapahtumapaikalta kerrottiin viedyn pois myös alle 10-vuotiaita lapsia. Loukkaantuneiden määrästä on kerrottu eri arvioita: BBC:n mukaan viiden ihmisen uskotaan loukkaantuneen, kun taas poliisiviranomainen Faisal Kamran kertoi kahdeksan lapsen saaneen vammoja ja olevan sairaalahoidossa.

## Rakennuksen kuntoa ja rakentamista tutkitaan

Kamranin mukaan opetuskeskus toimi vanhassa rakennuksessa, jossa oli keskeneräinen toinen kerros. Hänen mukaansa keskeneräisen kerroksen katto vaikuttaa romahtaneen heikkolaatuisen rakentamisen vuoksi. Viranomaiset eivät ole vielä kertoneet lopullista syytä romahdukselle, mutta tutkinta käynnistettiin pian tapahtuman jälkeen.

Poliisin mukaan opetuskeskuksen omistaja ja toinen henkilö on pidätetty tai otettu kiinni tapauksen vuoksi. BBC:n mukaan kaksi ihmistä otettiin kiinni osana alustavaa tutkintaa.

## Pelastajat etsivät mahdollisia loukkuun jääneitä

Kamran kertoi, että pelastajat jatkoivat raunioiden tutkimista saatuaan tietoja siitä, että lisää lapsia voisi olla jäänyt sortuneiden rakenteiden alle. Lähteiden mukaan kyse oli rakenteilla olleesta tai keskeneräisestä opetuskeskuksen osasta, jonka katto romahti lasten päälle.
summary_bullets: Ainakin 14 koululaista kuoli katon romahdettua opetuskeskuksessa Lahoren Kahnan alueella.
Useita lapsia loukkaantui, ja viranomaiset ovat kertoneet eri arvioita loukkaantuneiden määrästä.
Poliisi on ottanut kiinni opetuskeskuksen omistajan ja toisen henkilön, ja romahduksen syytä tutkitaan.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu useiden lähteiden yhteneviin tietoihin kuolonuhrien määrästä, sijainnista ja kiinniotoista. Loukkaantuneiden määrä esitetään varauksella, koska lähteissä oli eri arviot.
